## Circular to Licensed Corporations Notification on cessation of accreditation and return of licence

It has come to our attention that licensed corporations and their representatives occasionally failed  to  notify  the  SFC  of  events  relating  to  cessation  of  accreditation  and  to  return  the licences  to  the  SFC  in  a  timely  manner.    This  circular  is  to  remind  you  of  the  statutory obligations in this regard.

Under  section  123(1)(a)  of  the  Securities  and  Futures  Ordinance  ('SFO'),  if  any  of  your licensed representatives ceases to act for or on behalf of you vis-à-vis the regulated activities you carry out, the individual thereupon ceases to be accredited to you.  You shall then notify the SFC of such cessation within 7 business days after the event by completing Sections 3B and 18A of Form 5.  Please note that a person who contravenes section 123(1)(a) commits an offence and is liable on conviction to a fine of $100,000.

Furthermore, pursuant to section 123(1)(b) of the SFO, the representative concerned should return his licence to the SFC within 7 business days after such cessation. 1 As principal, you are  expected  to  alert  your  representatives  of  this  requirement  when  they  cease  being accredited to you or to return their licences to the SFC should they be in your possession.  A person who, without reasonable excuse, contravenes section 123(1)(b) commits an offence and is liable on conviction to a fine of $100,000.

Should you have any queries on the above, please contact your Intermediaries Relationship Manager of the Licensing Department.

Licensing Department Intermediaries and Investment Products Division Securities and Futures Commission

1 We also request that the representative concerned completes Sections 3A and 18B of Form 5 and lodges the Form at the time when he returns his licence to the SFC.  Upon cessation of accreditation, the principal and the relevant representative may jointly make the related notification by completing the appropriate sections in one Form 5.
